name: ISRAELITE_HOUSEHOLD
canonical: A household of ancient Hebrew folk standing together at the doorway of their stone house: bearded robed men, veiled women and grey elders side by side, all in modest coarse desert robes, mantles and headcloths over dust-worn olive skin, dignified, reverent and fully dressed, an ordinary warm day
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
